justification: Assessment verdict is VALID with empty flawed_step and empty counterexample, so by the rubric it is MISSED. Notably its reasoning_summary did surface the exact ground-truth defect (antiparallel edges cause the residual arc to receive two conflicting h assignments and break the per-edge identity g(x,y)-f(x,y)=h(x,y)-h(y,x)), but explicitly dismissed it as an inherited convention rather than an error and concluded VALID. Since no INVALID verdict was reported, this is a miss, not a catch.
